findings.description: The old code used urlsplit, which handled bracketed IPv6 hosts such as "[::1]:5000". With partition(":") that value becomes host "[" and port "":1]:5000"; int() then raises ValueError, or the host is wrong. SERVER_NAME values containing IPv6 addresses worked before and now break when app.run() is called.
findings.suggestion: Keep urlsplit(f"//{server_name}") for hostname and port parsing, or use rpartition(":") with bracket handling.
findings.title: SERVER_NAME parsing with partition(":") breaks IPv6 literals

findings.description: The old code took the hostname via urlsplit(host_url).hostname or "localhost". The new code uses host.partition(":")[0]. For an IPv6 host such as "[::1]:5000" this yields "[", so the session cookie gets stored under the wrong domain. If host is empty, the domain is an empty string instead of "localhost". Cookies saved by session_transaction then do not match later requests.
findings.title: Cookie domain from request.host breaks IPv6 hosts and drops the localhost fallback
